metaTitle: Custom Etched Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom etched lanyards and badges for a sleek, permanent brand impression. Perfect for corporate events and daily ID use.
introHtml: Etched lanyards and badges offer a permanent, upscale branding solution that resists fading and peeling over time. Unlike printed options, etching creates a subtle, debossed mark that stands out on metal badge holders or plastic ID cards. Ideal for corporate offices, trade shows, or security teams, these custom pieces convey durability and precision. Choose etched lanyards for a professional look that lasts through daily wear and repeated use.
heroAltText: Custom etched lanyards and badges with debossed branding for corporate ID and events.
